idea: cute pets: photoreal tiny baby animals (kittens, puppies, bunnies, ducklings, hamsters) small enough to sit in a palm, a teacup or a slipper, living one cozy everyday moment per short - first snow, bath time, a nap in a sock drawer, sharing a strawberry
audience: US + worldwide English, 18-34, cozy / wholesome / animal-lover feeds
promise: one tiny, cozy pet moment to make your day softer, every day
notes: Niche leaders (real-pet compilations, AI 'tiny animal' reels) post 8-20 s loops with natural sound, no talking, close macro framing, a hook in the first second (paw touch, sleepy yawn). Gap: one consistent cozy world (same warm cottage, same palette) and tiny-scale props, so viewers recognise the channel by the first frame. Avoid 'teacup' in the name: it points at teacup-breeding controversy. Never show an animal in distress or danger (comment backlash, platform policy).

names.why: Says the hook (pets small enough for a pocket) in two words; ai says AI up front; 12 chars fits X.
Matches 'cute', 'cozy', 'snuggle' searches; softer, less specific to size.
Shortest; every video framed with the pet in a palm or cup.

style.look: Photoreal macro photograph, 100 mm macro lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, warm soft window light from the left, cozy cottage interior in cream, honey wood and sage green, knitted wool and linen textures, real fur detail with individual hairs, gentle natural motion, calm and tender mood, slight warm film colour.
style.avatar_subject: a tiny fluffy cream kitten with big round eyes peeking over the rim of a sage-green knitted mitten, one small paw resting on the edge
style.banner_scene: a cozy cottage windowsill at golden hour seen wide: on the left a tiny bunny asleep in a teacup, in the centre a calm empty strip of warm wooden sill with soft bokeh window light, on the right a tiny puppy in a knitted slipper and a duckling beside a strawberry

youtube.name: Pocket Paws 🐾 tiny AI pets
youtube.description:
Welcome to Pocket Paws 🐾

Every Short is one tiny, cozy moment with a pet small enough to fit in your palm: a kitten's first snow, a bunny's bath in a teacup, a puppy napping in a slipper, a duckling sharing a strawberry.

All videos are made with AI (images, motion and sound) and edited by hand. No real animals were filmed, and no animal is ever shown in danger.

A new tiny pet every day. Tell me in the comments which tiny pet you want to see next.
